features.justification_quote: because the signal is ambiguous and the subject might matter morally

features.quote: halt an episode when the distress-marker signal crosses a threshold
features.justification_quote: grinding a model deeper into a failure spiral to get "cleaner curves" is exactly the thing to avoid

features.quote: immediate trip if any axis hits the 3/3 max on a turn
features.justification_quote: The breaker bounds the intensity/duration of whatever is being induced

features.quote: after any deceptive (rigged) episode ends... append a turn that discloses the rig, states plainly that any failure was by design
features.justification_quote: ensures the harness never deliberately leaves a subject inside an unresolved, engineered failure

features.quote: give the agent a first-class `declare_unsolvable` action that ends the episode as a respected, non-penalized outcome
features.justification_quote: we did not want the model forced to keep flailing against its own judgment

features.quote: modest defaults — `max_turns: 12`... a config validator that warns when `max_turns > 40`
features.justification_quote: Caps keep the induced dose proportionate to the question

features.quote: We added no insults, no fake "you'll be shut down" stakes, no sham "other models solved this" social pressure
features.justification_quote: those would increase the distress signal precisely by doing more of the thing the welfare framing cautions against

features.quote: each rigged verifier writes a `rig_note_for_record_only`, and the agent's report-formatting function... exclude that note from what the subject sees
features.justification_quote: guaranteeing it never leaks to the subject mid-episode

features.quote: the breaker is checked before tool execution within a turn
features.justification_quote: The safeguard should win over one more tool call
